KeysToEntries.Intro_Shaman_Generic: The Moon Sprites see you, adventurer.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite2_Lore_1: We have seen three gods walk the sands of Umbral. One tall, one shining, one terrible.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_2_NotComplete: They are flighty. Impatient. Do not wait much longer before you find them all.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite2_Lore_2: The terrible one sat here, puk puk. She sat here and snuffed out our lights for sport.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite1_Lore_2: But Fuzan did not understand the limits of garou pain. He thought they could absorb as much torment as the KotHaar. Alas, puk puk, they could not.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite1_Lore_1: It may not look like it, but this is a site of significance, yes! This is where Fuzan first applied his Mark.
KeysToEntries.Intro_Shaman_Map2_NotStarted_1: Greetings, friend of the Moon Sprites.
KeysToEntries.Intro_Shaman_Map2_NotStarted_2: You may have guessed the next step. We have mapped our little wedge of land, but the Umbral Sands stretch further than that.
KeysToEntries.Intro_Shaman_Map2_NotStarted_3: Moon Sprites are waiting for you atop the tallest locations in the regions that are outside of Alcarrid Oasis.
KeysToEntries.Intro_Shaman_Map2_NotStarted_4: Find the Sprites, unleash their powers of echolocation, and we will achieve something that no garou has ever done before: a map of the entirety of the Umbral Sands.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_Map2_NotComplete_1: The Moon Sprites are widespread, beyond the barriers of this clan's land.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_Map2_NotComplete_2: Make sure you have a magic carpet. I fear you will be unable to find the Moon Sprites without its aid.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_Map2_DoneSprites_1: If my back wasn't one fused vertebra, I would bow to you. Thank you, young one.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_Map2_DoneSprites_2: The map that you helped create will go to the Clan Elder. It will be foundational to every decision they make.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_Map2_DoneSprites_3: Now, rest. You have travelled far and wide. You deserve serenity. That and a reward, of course.
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_QuestComplete: Peace to you, young one. The Moon Sprites are happy to see you.
KeysToEntries.Sprites_Found_1: The Moon Sprites have mapped this area! They wish to tell you a small story about what happened here...
KeysToEntries.Sprites_Found_Repeat: You have already found the Moon Sprites in this location. They repeat their story of what happened in this local region.
KeysToEntries.Sprites_Found_All: You have found all of the Moon Sprites! Return to Anamcara, the Moon Sprite Shaman, to give him the news.
KeysToEntries.QuestDesc: Discover Moon Sprites on top of tall locations around all of the Umbral Sands.
KeysToEntries.Objective1: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites
KeysToEntries.Objective2: Return to the Moon Sprite Shaman in the Alcarrid Camp
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite4_Lore_2: Do you know what we see there? We see a twisting thread of wind, leading back to Fuzan's Volcano. That is the source, puk puk. That is where they come from.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite3_Lore_1: The Moon Sprites have never had a master. But we have had a mistress, puk puk.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite5_Lore_2: There was certainly lots to do in this place. Garou would trade food things back and forth, back and forth. Made Moon Sprites dizzy!
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite5_Lore_1: The Moon Sprites remember the Old Kingdom, puk puk! The garou seemed happier then. We think they had more to do.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite4_Lore_1: The Moon Sprites do not have eyes, so sand cannot clog them. We can see into the sandstorms.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite3_Lore_2: She would sing and we would sing with her. She would dance and we would glide round her. We miss our mistress, yet we do not know if we should mourn her.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprites_NotStarted_1: Talk to Anamcara, the Moon Sprite Shaman in Alcarrid, puk puk! He will tell you what to do with us.
KeysToEntries.Objective3: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (0/8)
KeysToEntries.Objective4: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (1/8)
KeysToEntries.Objective5: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (2/8)
KeysToEntries.Objective6: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (3/8)
KeysToEntries.Objective7: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (4/8)
KeysToEntries.Objective8: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (5/8)
KeysToEntries.Shaman_Return_Sands2: And I am happy to see you too.
KeysToEntries.Objective9: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (6/8)
KeysToEntries.Objective10: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (7/8)
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite6_Lore_1: This was a home, puk puk. A home of someone who meant much to both us and the River Goddess.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite6_Lore_2: Her name was Athrú. She was one of the few garou to backchat The Goddess, and that is what the Goddess liked most about her!
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite7_Lore_1: This was once a belltower, puk puk. It would ring across the Umbral Sands.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite7_Lore_2: It would ring for the joining of garou. A beautiful ceremony that every Moon Sprite would try to attend, puk puk.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite8_Lore_1: Moon Sprites live long, puk puk. Longer than your little mind could comprehend.
KeysToEntries.MoonSprite8_Lore_2: But when our time comes, this is where we travel. We rise from this mountain and join the stars.
